clue.text: Local restorer renovated railway

indicators.note: something renovated is done over and rebuilt, so the letters of these two words are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: A local man restores an old railway line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'renovated' rearranges LOCAL RESTORER, thirteen letters, into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A fairground ride on a looping track is called a railway, so the switchback ride fits the word.

clue.text: A sign of terror I displayed, all at sea in stormy area

indicators.note: all at sea means confused and disordered, so these letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A frightened sailor shows terror in a storm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'all at sea' rearranges A SIGN OF TERROR I.
explanation.definitionFit: The windy southern ocean latitudes between forty and fifty degrees are notorious for storms.

clue.text: Merry and bright

explanation.surface: A cheerful, sunny disposition.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is slang for drunk and also means illuminated.

clue.text: Hesitation shown about extremely old article each second

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the hesitation goes round the other pieces

parts.note: er is the sound of hesitation
extremely means very
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: Someone hesitates each second over a very old article.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' signals that the hesitation sound wraps round the other three pieces; 'shown' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Each second item, skipping one between, means alternate ones.

clue.text: Smart fellow in yellow

parts.note: chic means stylishly smart
Ken is a man's name

explanation.surface: A stylish man dressed in yellow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'yellow' means cowardly.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words are slang for cowardly.

clue.text: A man welcomed by mother country

indicators.note: welcomed by means taken in, placed inside

parts.note: ma is mother
Eric is a man's name

explanation.surface: A man is welcomed home by his mother.
explanation.walkthrough: 'welcomed by' means the man's name goes inside the word for mother, with A in front.
explanation.definitionFit: The United States is often called by this name.

clue.text: Work as money-collector

explanation.surface: Someone works as a collector of money.
explanation.definitionFit: A cash register in a shop, and to cultivate the ground.

clue.text: Boisterous players get plastered

parts.note: rough means boisterous
the cast is the players in a play

explanation.surface: Rowdy actors get drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plastered' looks like drunk, but it means coated with plaster.
explanation.definitionFit: Coated with a rough plaster of gravel and lime.

clue.text: Depending on circumstances at sea, became shy, shaky

indicators.note: shaky means unsteady, so the letters wobble into a new order

explanation.surface: At sea, someone became shy and shaky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shaky' rearranges AT SEA BECAME SHY.
explanation.definitionFit: Equivalent to 'according to the situation'.

clue.text: Where this puzzle was set? Not quite then

indicators.note: not quite means the phrase stops just short, losing its final letter

parts.note: the puzzle was compiled at The Times newspaper

explanation.surface: A question about where the crossword was compiled, answered with a vague 'then'.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not quite' drops the last letter of the phrase AT THE TIMES, the newspaper that printed this puzzle.
explanation.definitionFit: Both phrases point to a moment in the past, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: King's champion in the ring

definitions.meaning: King's reads as 'King is': the name of many French kings
a boxing champion, Joe ..., world heavyweight champion 1937-49

explanation.surface: A royal champion fighting in a ring.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of King's is 'is', linking the two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: The name was borne by eighteen French monarchs and by the American heavyweight boxer Joe Louis.

clue.text: Just sparing a shilling — that's mean

indicators.note: sparing here means doing without, so one letter is left out of the word for just

parts.note: just means simply, as in 'just stupid'
S is the abbreviation for a shilling in old British money

explanation.surface: Someone thinks sparing a shilling is mean-spirited.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sparing' removes S, a shilling (an old British coin, s. in pre-1971 money), from SIMPLY.
explanation.definitionFit: To imply something is to suggest or signify it, which is one sense of mean.

clue.text: By the sound of it, a silly contract

indicators.note: this phrase says the word is identified by how it sounds when spoken

parts.note: a silly is a foolish person, a nit in British slang

explanation.surface: Someone thinks a contract sounds silly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a silly' is a noun here: a silly person, a NIT. The answer sounds the same, the K being silent.
explanation.definitionFit: To knit the brows is to draw them together, to contract them.

clue.text: Sophy has broken up with husband

indicators.note: broken up means the letters of the word has are smashed and rearranged

explanation.surface: A woman named Sophy has split from her husband.
explanation.walkthrough: Sophy looks like a woman's name, but it is an old title for the ruler of Persia. 'broken up' rearranges the three letters of 'has', and the husband's letter follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Sophy is an archaic title for a Persian monarch, the same ruler later styled by this title.

clue.text: Time off for lecturer at basic lab complex

indicators.note: complex means intricate and tangled, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A lecturer takes time off at a complicated laboratory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'complex' rearranges AT BASIC LAB.
explanation.definitionFit: An academic's paid leave for study or travel.

clue.text: In general, the old choose to be scintillating

indicators.note: in places the first piece inside the word that follows it

parts.note: GEN is short for general, as in general information
list is an archaic verb meaning to choose or please, as in 'the wind bloweth where it listeth'

explanation.surface: Old people choosing, in general, to sparkle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' signals the archaic verb (hence 'the old') goes inside the short form of general.
explanation.definitionFit: To glisten is to shine with a sparkling light, which is to scintillate.

clue.text: While travelling, I've taken off with no object

indicators.note: taken off means those letters are removed

parts.note: an intransitive verb takes no object
the letters of I've

explanation.surface: A traveller has removed something for no reason.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken off' removes I'VE from INTRANSITIVE, the grammar term for a verb with no object.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on the way somewhere, en route.

clue.text: Men of intelligence — scholar, painter — brought back old language

indicators.note: brought back means the whole run of pieces is read in reverse order

parts.note: the CIA is the US Central Intelligence Agency
an MA, Master of Arts, is a scholar
an RA is a Royal Academician, a painter

explanation.surface: Spies, an academic and an artist revive an ancient tongue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought back' reverses CIA MA RA as one run, giving the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: This ancient Semitic tongue was spoken in the Near East and is thought to be the speech of Jesus.

clue.text: Greyish cereal with breakfast, perhaps

parts.note: oats are a cereal crop
breakfast is an example of a meal

explanation.surface: A bowl of grey cereal served at breakfast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Greyish cereal' looks like a single phrase; the definition is only 'Greyish', the colour.
explanation.definitionFit: The name of the porridge grain is also a pale greyish-fawn colour.

clue.text: Left mount abandoned by son, the young bounder

parts.note: L is left

indicators.note: abandoned by means one letter is dropped from the mountain

parts.note: Mount Everest
S is son

explanation.surface: A son leaves a mountain on the left.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abandoned by' removes S from EVEREST, after L.
explanation.definitionFit: A young hare, which bounds.

clue.text: A conspirator moving right up tree

indicators.note: moving says one letter of the conspirator's name shifts to a new place

parts.note: Brutus conspired to assassinate Julius Caesar

explanation.surface: A conspirator climbing up a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving right up' shifts the R of the conspirator's name earlier, ahead of the B, after A.
explanation.definitionFit: The strawberry tree is the familiar species of this evergreen genus.

clue.text: Contract in a game like whist.

parts.note: bridge is a card game derived from whist

explanation.surface: A contract made in a card game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Contract' looks like the bridge term, but it means shorten.
explanation.definitionFit: To abridge a text is to shorten or condense it.

clue.text: Dreadful driver starting to overtake, and dithering

indicators.note: starting means each of the following words gives its opening letter

explanation.surface: A bad motorist begins to overtake and then hesitates.
explanation.walkthrough: Mr Toad of The Wind in the Willows is the reckless motorist.
explanation.definitionFit: Toad of Toad Hall is a famous literary motoring menace, crashing car after car.

clue.text: Session of play finished

definitions.meaning: in cricket, a set of six balls bowled from one end

explanation.surface: A session of play has come to an end.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a session of six balls bowled from one end has this name.
explanation.definitionFit: A cricket term for a bowling spell of six deliveries, and an everyday word for ended.

clue.text: It's symbolic when child is given short measure

parts.note: a tot is a small child
an em is a small printer's measure of width

explanation.surface: Short-changing a child is a symbolic act.
explanation.walkthrough: An EM is a printer's unit of width, the breadth of the letter M.
explanation.definitionFit: A carved emblem standing for a clan or family is a symbolic object.

clue.text: Contrariwise, it was first put on roof

indicators.note: contrariwise means the other way round, so the word is reversed

parts.note: led means was first

explanation.surface: It was put on the roof first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Contrariwise' turns IT to TI.
explanation.definitionFit: Covered with slates or tiles, as a roof.

clue.text: Criticism of side not new

indicators.note: not means without, so one letter is dropped

parts.note: flank means side
N is new

explanation.surface: Criticism of a side, not new.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' removes N from FLANK.
explanation.definitionFit: Anti-aircraft fire, figuratively strong criticism.

clue.text: Frame required for picture — a self-portrait

indicators.note: a portrait shows a likeness within a picture, so the letters are found inside these words

explanation.surface: An artist needs a frame to paint a self-portrait.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits inside 'picturE A SELf'.
explanation.definitionFit: An artist's stand is a wooden frame for holding a canvas.

clue.text: A lot of police around, infiltrating demo completely

indicators.note: infiltrating means one piece gets inside another

parts.note: a demo, demonstration, is a rally

indicators.note: around means turned round, read in reverse

parts.note: the CID is the detective branch of British police

explanation.surface: Police surround and infiltrate a protest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' turns A plus the detective branch backwards to DICA; 'infiltrating' puts that inside the demo.
explanation.definitionFit: Radically means fundamentally, thoroughly, to the root.

clue.text: Uncle will give up drink

definitions.meaning: uncle is slang for a pawnbroker, who accepts pledges

explanation.surface: An uncle swears off alcohol.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Uncle' is old slang for a pawnbroker, who accepts goods as security.
explanation.definitionFit: A pawnbroker accepts goods as security; the phrase also means swearing to stay teetotal.
